title: Erdos 708: Controlled Cores and Joint Divisor Certificates
proof_status: New derivations with separate internal mathematical audits

external_quadratic_gate.statement: M >= 16 n^2 implies an integer cover of at most 2n positions
external_quadratic_gate.attribution: Ziming Wang, written working manuscript, Appendix A

new_restricted_results: Diffuse-core joint hinge theorem with one distinct outside prime per source
Zero-defect extension with one arbitrary substantial core coordinate
Controlled-core defect B(epsilon,k)(1+|R|) independent of M, improved by an aggregate cap
Integer asymptotic coefficient two for a designated core of at most c0*(log M)^2/log log M primes for some absolute c0>0, and one distinct outside prime per source
Explicit elementary variant with core size at most 10^(-6)*(log M/log log M)^2
Direct global construction combining exact core-part bins, nested outside-prime-power matchings, and repair of sparse exceptional core demands
Arbitrary pure-small-core sources absorbed into a common hinge budget
Discounted certificate with two explicit positive-overlap bounds
Integer asymptotic coefficient two for separated prime supports at every fixed positive power cutoff
An explicit shrinking-power cutoff under quantitative error conditions
Uniform large-mean exact H2 criterion with limiting threshold 241/136
dependent_scope_check: Prime-disjoint source components with support size o(log M) already have eventual exact 2n covers by the external quadratic gate and Rankin counting; not promoted as an independent new frontier
remaining_sufficient_goal: Uniform Delta_(2+epsilon)(A,I,w)=o(n) for every clipped vector on the full minimal-obstruction demand core
main_remaining_limitation: The substantial core can be much larger than O(log log n); the present finite-difference variation grows exponentially in its size
exact_endpoint_additional_gap: An asymptotic hinge bound alone does not remove the o(n) slack or integer rounding to yield exact 2n

validation.mathematical_checks: Separate internal audits of all principal new proofs, quantitative corollaries, and integer transfer
validation.small_exact_count_example: Aggregate core tail on {11,13,17}: prefix 5 versus shifted interval 4; not a counterexample to problem 708
